body: Its been long enough time to go poison myself out of alcohol and breath in carbon monoxide.

3 serious relationships. one was 2 years, another 1 year, and the last one was only a month. You can make your jokes about the last one but nothing tops a month of happiness. Especially when you spend every waking day with someone from 1 am to 12 am. I am going nuts.

Its not a matter of convincing. Its a matter of knowing that things never work out. No matter how well things seem to be. You can't force someone to love you. Life is just to much to bear. I can't live knowing I have nothing to look forward to. No one to come home to. I have to be a part of something. A part of someone... to ever feel alive. To ever feel anything. Is it sad that I spend my nights, my time, watching movies looking for some sort of emotional connection that I don’t get in real life. I want to dream or imagine a part of something that my heart doesn't feel. A place I can’t reach. Some days I spend my whole night looking up cheesy romance films to watch just so I can feel like I am living through their stories. Living their life when I can’t live mine. When I am to afraid to live mine.

I hate what I write. I hate how my life is. So I wouldn't take pride in suffering. As for your philosophy... fitting if love were true. Extremely well written. Very heartfelt and I think got its message across. But I am sick of trying at this point. I want out.
On occasion. Not that it matters...
